name: 5Nights no Obieru Koro ni
source: A doujin kinetic visual novel series released by Anon Makiz, and based on indie-horror game Five Nights at Freddy's and (partially) on another doujin horror visual novels Higurashi no Naku Koro ni.
translation: 由Anon Makiz发行的同人动感视觉小说系列，改编自独立恐怖游戏《玩具熊的五夜后宫》和（部分）另一部同人恐怖视觉小说《寒蝉鸣泣之时》。
